Congratulations to Ryan Coogler on taking home the Oscar. See more Oscar acceptance speeches and highlights on Oscars.com. ...more ...more 244 Comments Add a comment... Sinners got by far the most love in the room. Deserved that guy is a genius Ryan Coogler is in the MARVEL universe as well so it was extra sweet seeing him accept the award from Iron Man and Captain America. I love how he always brings up that he is from Oakland. We from the Bay Area are so absolutely proud of where we came from and to see one of our own receive these accolades is beyond heartwarming & deserved!! YES!! RDJ was like, “That’s what the $&#% I’m talking about!!” when he embraced Ryan :) Ryan Coogler is on a generational run right now. He deserved that Oscar!
